description_en: Creates a system rule by calling the CreateSystemRule operation
description_zh: 调用CreateSystemRule接口创建系统规则
kebab_example: aliyun ahas-openapi create-system-rule --namespace default --app-name ahas-demo --metric-type 4 --threshold 0.6 --enable true --ahas-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSystemRule

parameters.help_en: The application name. If the application is an EDAS application, set AppName to the App ID in EDAS. You can view the corresponding ID in the EDAS console by choosing **Application Management > Basic Information**
parameters.help_zh: 应用名，若为EDAS应用，则AppName为EDAS中的App ID，可在EDAS控制台“应用管理>基本信息”中查看对应的ID
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The statistical dimension. Valid values: 0: Load. 1: average RT of inbound traffic. 2: thread count. 3: total inbound QPS. 4: CPU usage
parameters.help_zh: 统计维度，0表示Load，1表示入口平均RT，2表示线程数，3表示入口总QPS，4表示CPU使用率
parameters.name: metric_type

parameters.help_en: The CPU threshold. Valid values: 0 to 1
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the rule is enabled
parameters.name: enable
